name: shots
description: Label a long source's shots once: a sheet a shot, then labels; add b-roll by shot. One call finds where the picture changes (shots with start, end and a motion score) and answers ONE sheet, a tile per shot, numbered; a call with labels saves a few words per shot by number. Kept beside the file, read back by later calls and by get_project; edit_timeline adds b-roll by shot (source, shot) with its real in and out.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {clip, src, shots: [{n, start, end, motion, label?}], sheet?}: the sheet only without labels.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: clip
params.description: The source's clip id (clip-9), or a timeline item id.

params.name: labels
params.description: Labels by shot number, a JSON object: {"7": "mannequin pulled out"}. A few words each, what happens in the shot; "" removes one.

params.name: redetect
params.description: Find the shots again; the labels of shots still there are kept.
